_doc: Structural prototypes for Glint-V2. STRUCTURAL ONLY — never include topic verticals (medical, health, finance, etc.) as prototypes. The Glint lesson: prototypes encode difficulty profile, not topic, so topic prototypes create false positives. Centroids are filled in by router_model/train.py from training data; this file seeds the schema and initial example names.
_doc_thresholds: Per-prototype similarity threshold (in gateway-policy.json: prototype_thresholds). Higher = stricter matching.
_doc_kind_enforcement: trainer_worker.py refuses to add a prototype with kind='topic'. Only kind='structural' allowed.

prototypes.name: system_design
prototypes.description: High-level system architecture, scaling, distributed systems design
centroid_seed_text: Design a URL shortener that handles 10K requests per second
How would you design Twitter's timeline at scale
Design a distributed rate limiter
Design a chat system like WhatsApp
Architect a video streaming platform
Design a real-time notification system
How would you build a distributed cache
prototypes._doc_centroid: Computed by router_model/train.py from centroid_seed_text after embedding. 64-d vector. Null until first training run.

_doc_growth: Auto-grow via trainer_worker.py. Only structural kind allowed. New prototypes are computed from training samples where vertical in [system_design, hard_programming, complex_debugging, codebase_search, code_review, planning, architecture] AND curated_count > threshold. Centroid = mean(embeddings of curated samples).
_doc_growth_protection: If a 'medical' or 'finance' or other topic vertical ever tries to register as a prototype, REFUSE with error: 'topic prototypes are forbidden — see Glint Roman Empire lesson in README.'
